# Lynn actions

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_lynn_stage.py from tools/lynn_actions.py; edit the catalog, not this file. -->

The Lynn page (left of Overview) shows a large full-body Lynn drawn on a 64-pixel grid and scaled 3x, animated at 24 fps. Each drawing is held for several ticks, as in hand-made pixel animation, while the patting hand, water drops, paper plane and emote bubbles move every tick.

She has 10 idle activities and 31 interactions. Between activities she breathes, blinks and glances around; every 8-15 seconds she starts a random idle activity (entry, a random number of loops, exit). Interactions interrupt her, play once and return to idle.

## Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| OK click, double click or long press | Record five seconds of speech for Lynn |
| UP/DOWN long press | No action on this page |
| UP / DOWN | Previous / next page |

## Agent tools

Every action is an agent tool. [`lynn-tools.json`](lynn-tools.json) contains tool definitions (`lynn_play_action`, `lynn_say`, `lynn_list_actions`, `lynn_status`) with JSON input schemas and the full action list. The [Grok connector](../connector/README.md) exposes all 41 actions as individual MCP tools and accepts voice uploads. Network events apply only on the awake Lynn page. A host agent can also use the USB serial console, one command per line:

| Tool | Serial command |
| --- | --- |
| `lynn_play_action` | `lynn play <action> [line]` |
| `lynn_say` | `lynn say <text>` |
| `lynn_list_actions` | `lynn list` |
| `lynn_status` | `lynn status` |

Serial commands switch to the Lynn page and wake the screen; network commands never switch pages. Lines are UTF-8, up to about 30 characters; characters outside the 12 px font (GB2312 level 1 and ASCII) show as placeholder boxes.

## Adding an action

1. Describe new drawings in `tools/lynn_art.py`, then generate keys and in-betweens with `python3 tools/lynn_art.py --phase keys|inbetweens` and the image-gen batch script.
2. Clean them with `python3 tools/gen_lynn_stage.py --prep` and review them; they land in `assets/images/lynn_stage/`.
3. Add the timeline to `tools/lynn_actions.py` and run `python3 tools/gen_lynn_stage.py`.
4. Check it with `tools/lynn_stage_preview/run.sh <id>`, then run the host tests.
